The Celebrations

Four days of colour, laughter and tradition — we'd love for you to join us for as many as you can.

28 NOVEMBER 2026  ·  5:00 PM

Haldi

A joyful evening of turmeric, music and blessings, as the families come together to mark the beginning of the celebrations.

1 DECEMBER 2026  ·  10:00 AM

Mayra & Mandap

A heartfelt morning ritual as the maternal family arrives with gifts and blessings, followed by the mandap ceremony.

1 DECEMBER 2026  ·  8:00 PM

Bindoli

A vibrant evening procession filled with music, dance and celebration as the festivities build toward the big day.

2 DECEMBER 2026  ·  9:45 AM

The Wedding

The sacred ceremony uniting Durgesh and Jaimala, at Kolyari, Udaipur — the moment we've all been waiting for.

4 DECEMBER 2026  ·  6:00 PM

Reception

An evening to celebrate the newlyweds with dinner, dancing and heartfelt wishes for their new journey.
